command: pnpm exec vp test bench --run --outputJson bench/results/define.json

conditions.cache: Warm in-process JavaScript; inputs constructed outside timing; cold build not measured.
conditions.concurrency: Sequential benchmarks; no competing task-owned benchmark jobs.
conditions.environment: Shared virtualized host; scheduling and GC noise included.

boundaries: Style.define validation, copying, and freezing only. No CSS emitter, bundler, browser, or native renderer exists in this phase. Their sizes and timings are not measured.
normalization: Only report filepath converted to repository-relative form. Timings, variance, and sample counts are unchanged.
